items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: Now, he called me and he called Larry McKinley. And that's how we got on the staff to give life to the Jazz and Heritage Festival.

ctx.x: How did you get involved with jazz, with jazz, founding of Jazz Festival?

One of the, one of the great Italian friends of mine, Al Boleto, is the young man that got me involved. We see, Al and I had done jazz shows together at Booker T. Washington Auditorium. and we were very, very good friends. I called Al my brother, my American brother. And he is all American. He has never changed. He's still the same way with me. And I can remember when he was managing the Playboy Club. I had caught Blanche any time I went to the Playboy Club. Well, Al and I developed this friendship. Well, New…
So that first group was the jumping off point for the Jazz and Heritage Festival.
